def solve(g, minsize=3, par=None):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    t=min(i for i,_ in cells); b=max(i for i,_ in cells)
    l=min(j for _,j in cells); r=max(j for _,j in cells)
    def frame(d):
        a=t+d; bb=b-d; cc=l+d; dd=r-d
        return a,bb,cc,dd
    # determine color pattern from demos: even->5 outline, odd->2 solid
    out=g
    for d in range(0,20):
        a,b2,c,d_=frame(d)

def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    t=min(i for i,_ in cells); b=max(i for i,_ in cells)
    l=min(j for _,j in cells); r=max(j for _,j in cells)
    def out(a,b,c,d,col):
        for j in range(c,d+1): g[a][j]=col; g[b][j]=col
        for i in range(a,b+1): g[i][c]=col; g[i][d]=col
    d=0
    while True:
        a=t+d; bb=b-d; cc=l+d; dd=r-d
        if a>bb or cc>dd or min(bb-a+1,dd-cc+1)<2: break
        out(a,bb,cc,dd, 5 if d%2==0 else 2)
        d+=1
    return g

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cs=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=0]
    t=min(i for i,_ in cs); b=max(i for i,_ in cs)
    l=min(j for _,j in cs); r=max(j for _,j in cs)
    h=b-t+1; w=r-l+1
    o=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    def paint(row_start,row_end,col_start,col_end,color):
        for j in range(col_start,col_end+1): o[row_start][j]=o[row_end][j]=color
        for i in range(row_start,row_end+1): o[i][col_start]=o[i][col_end]=color
    ks=range((h-1)//2+1)
    for k in ks:
        rs=k+t; re=b-k; cs_=l+k; ce=r-k
        if rs<=re and cs_<=ce:
            color=5 if k%2==0 else 2
            paint(rs,re,cs_,ce,color)
    # center handling
    if h%2==1 and w%2==1 and (t+(h-1)//2, l+(w-1)//2) not in [(i,j) for i in range(t,b) for j in range(l,r)]: pass
    return o

def rings(out):

    # find distinct colored rectangular frames by layering: 
    # use set of non-bg cells; determine bounding box of all colored cells -> outer frame

    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return out, r0,r1,c0,c1

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=0]
    rs=[a for a,_ in cells]; cs=[b for _,b in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    layers=[((r0,r1),(c0,c1)),((r0+1,r1-1),(c0+1,c1-1)),((r0+2,r1-2),(c0+2,c1-2))]
    for k,(rA,rB),(cA,cB) in enumerate(layers):

from collections import Counter
def frames_of(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    res=[]
    for r0 in range(H):
        for c0 in range(W):
            col=g[r0][c0]
            if col==0: continue
            best=None
            for h_ in range(1,H-r0+1):
                for w_ in range(1,W-c0+1):
                    r1=r0+h_-1; c1=c0+w_-1
                    ok=True
                    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                        if g[r0][j]!=col or g[r1][j]!=col: ok=False;break
                    if not ok: continue
                    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
                        if g[i][c0]!=col or g[i][c1]!=col: ok=False;break
                    if not ok: continue
                    # maximality test
                    up = (r0>0 and all(g[r0-1][j]==col for j in range(c0,c1+1)))

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    r0=min(i for i,_ in cells); r1=max(i for i,_ in cells)
    c0=min(j for _,j in cells); c1=max(j for _,j in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for k in range((r1-r0)//2+1):
        a,b,c,d=r0+k,r1-k,c0+k,c1-k
        if a>b or c>d: break
        col=5 if k%2==0 else 2

            if out[a][j]==0: out[a][j]=col
            if out[b][j]==0: out[b][j]=col
        for i in range(a,b+1):
            if out[i][c]==0: out[i][c]=col
            if out[i][d]==0: out[i][d]=col
    return out

def f(g):

def fb(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=0]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in cells); r1=max(i for i,_ in cells)
    c0=min(j for _,j in cells); c1=max(j for _,j in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for k in range((r1-r0)//2+1):
        a,b,c,d=r0+k,r1-k,c0+k,c1-k
        if a>b or c>d: break
        col=5 if k%2==0 else 2
        for j in range(c,d+1): out[a][j]=col; out[b][j]=col
        for i in range(a,b+1): out[i][c]=col; out[i][d]=col
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, fb(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
o=fb(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(o))

def build(H,W,size,col):
    r0=(H-size)//2; c0=(W-size)//2
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for j in range(c0,c0+size): out[r0][j]=col; out[r0+size-1][j]=col
    for i in range(r0,r0+size): out[i][c0]=col; out[i][c0+size-1]=col
    return out

# So rule: nested rings, each subsequent ring shrinks by 2 in both dims, colors alternate, painted only onto background cells (later smaller rings overwrite nothing since painted outside-in with skip).
def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=0]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in cells); r1=max(i for i,_ in cells)
    c0=min(j for _,j in cells); c1=max(j for _,j in cells)
    mr=(r0+r1)//2; mc=(c0+c1)//2
    # number of rings: shrink until size1 or ...; find max depth such that ring fits: use min(r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1) stepped down by 2
    h=r1-r0+1; w=c1-c0+1; sz=max(h,w)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    col=g[r0][c0]
    while True:
        s=sz
        rr=s//2; cc=s//2
        rs=mr-rr; re=mr+rr+(s%2); cs_=mc-cc; ce=mc+cc+(s%2)
        if rs<0 or re>H or cs_<0 or ce>=W: break
        for i in range(rs,re):
            for j in (cs_,ce):
                if out[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=col
        for j in range(cs_,ce):
            for i in (rs,re):
                if out[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=col
        if s==1: break
        sz-=2; col=6-col
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=0; non=[x for r in g for x in r if x!=bg]
    col=max(set(non),key=non.count)

    rec(r0,r1,c0,c1,0)
    return res

def f(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    best=None
    for size in range(3,H+1):
        for top in range(H-size+1):
            for left in range(W-size+1):
                col=inp[top][left]
                if all(inp[top][j]==col for j in range(left,left+size)) and \
                   all(inp[top+size-1][j]==col for j in range(left,left+size)) and \
                   all(inp[i][left]==col for i in range(top,top+size)) and \
                   all(inp[i][left+size-1]==col for i in range(top,top+size)):
                    best=(top,left,size,col)
    top,left,size,col=best
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for kk in range(1,(size-1)//2):
        tr=top+kk; br=top+size-1-kk; lr=left+kk; rr=left+size-1-kk
        c_=5 if kk%2 else 2
        for j in range(lr,rr+1): out[tr][j]=out[br][j]=c_
        for i in range(tr,br+1): out[i][lr]=out[i][rr]=c_
    return out

def f(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    bg=max(set(sum(inp,[])), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in inp))
    # find border color: most common nonzero color on frame edges
    from collections import Counter
    edge=[inp[0][j] for j in range(W)]+[inp[H-1][j] for j in range(W)]+[inp[i][0] for i in range(H)][::1]
    edge=[e for e in edge if e!=bg]
    bc=Counter(edge).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # bounding box of border color
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(inp[i][j]==bc for j in range(W))]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if any(inp[i][j]==bc for i in range(H))]
    top=min(rows); bot=max(rows); left=min(cols); right=max(cols)
    size=bot-top+1
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for d in range(1,(size-1)//2+1):
        for i in (top+d, bot-d):
            for j in range(left,right+1):
                if inp[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=2 if d%4==2 else 5
        for j in (left+d, right-d):
            for i in range(top,bot+1):
                if inp[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=2 if d%4==2 else 5

from collections import Counter
def f(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    bg=max(set(sum(inp,[])), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in inp))
    # bounding square of the non-bg color present on the frame
    cand=[]
    for c in set(sum(inp,[])):
        if c==bg: continue
        rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(inp[i][j]==c for j in range(W))]
        if not rows: continue
        # must form full border rectangle
        top=min(rows); bot=max(rows)
        ok=True
        for i in (top,bot):
            for j in range(W):
                if inp[i][j]!=c: ok=False; break
            if not ok: break
        if not ok: continue
        left=min(j for j in range(W) if any(inp[i][j]==c for i in range(top,bot+1)))
        right=max(j for j in range(W) if any(inp[i][j]==c for i in range(top,bot+1)))
        if min(left,right)<0 or True: pass
        if abs(right-left)!=abs(bot-top)-1 or left!=right-(bot-top): continue
        cand.append((top,left,bot-right+1,c))
    if not cand: return [r[:] for r in inp]
    top,lc,bot,cc=cand[0]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    R=(bot-top)//2  # ring depth inward
    for r in range(1,R+1):
        if r%4==0: continue
        col_=2 if r%2==0 else cc
        # paint only cells that are background now
        for i,j in ((top+r,col_), ) : pass
        for i in (top+r, bot-r):
            for j in range(lc,r+lc+bot-lc):
                pass
        for i in range(top,r+top+bot-top):
            pass
    return out

def g(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    bg=max(set(sum(inp,[])), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in inp))
    best=None
    for c in set(sum(inp,[])):
        if c==bg: continue
        rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(inp[i][j]==c for j in range(W))]
        top=min(rows); bot=max(rows)
        ok=True
        for i in range(top,bot+1):
            for j in range(W):
                if inp[i][j]!=c: ok=False; break
            if not ok: break
        if not ok: continue
        cols=[j for j in range(W) if any(inp[i][j]==c for i in range(top,bot+1))]
        lc=min(cols); rc=max(cols)
        if lc!=top and rc!=bot and bot-top==rc-lc:  # symmetric square frame
            best=(top,lc,bot,rc,c)
    if not best: return [r[:] for r in inp]
    top,lc,bot,rc,cc=best
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    n=(bot-top)//2
    for r in range(1,n+1):
        if r%4==0: continue
        cl=2 if r%2==0 else cc
        for i in (top+r,bot-r):
            for j in range(lc,rc+1):
                if out[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=cl
        for j in (lc+r,rc-r):
            for i in range(top,bot+1):
                if out[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=cl
    return out

import json
def f(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=0]
    col=inp[pts[0][0]][pts[0][1]]
    ts=min(i for i,_ in pts); bs=max(i for i,_ in pts)
    ls=min(j for _,j in pts); rs=max(j for _,j in pts)
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for i in range(ts+1,bs):
        for j in range(ls+1,rs):
            if inp[i][j]==0:
                d=min(i-ts, bs-i, j-ls, rs-j)
                p=d%4
                if p==0: out[i][j]=2
                elif p==2: out[i][j]=0
                else: out[i][j]=col
    return out

def f(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    seq=[0,5,2,5]  # ring color by distance to nearest frame edge
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if inp[i][j]==0:
                dd=min(i,H-1-i,min(j,W-1-j))  # Chebyshev ring index from nearest edge
                out[i][j]=seq[dd%4]
    return out
